source: KatFish (Park et al., 470 human vs 1,624 LLM texts; 771 essays, 945 poems, 378 abstracts) + LREAD human-reading experiment
notes: metric-engineer imports this baseline unchanged for z-score calculation. Unpublished cells are null. When supplementing with a user corpus, append ',user-corpus-{date}' to source.

comma_pos_diversity.note: Weak discrimination in poetry; requires a genre guard

comma_relative_position.note: Estimate from report body; detailed cell unpublished

z_score_thresholds.comments: The report's detection-algorithm section adds weight at z>1.0. Compare document measurements with the genre baseline and add weight to metrics whose z-score exceeds 1.0. Supplement news/qa/blog with a user corpus. Recommend a genre=='poetry' guard because comma_pos_diversity weakly separates poetry.

lread_calibration.comments: Phase 1 intuition at 60% does not differ statistically from chance (p=.362); general readers struggle to identify AI Korean. Providing the Phase 2 rubric (commas, connective endings, concluding/balance vocabulary, aligned with our taxonomy) raises accuracy to 90%. The v1.6 detector directly incorporates LREAD rubric metrics; reaching 90% human-reading accuracy is its first KPI.

merge.patch: Formally cite four lexicon entries and thresholds
Specify three hanja_nominalizers and an enhanced S2 threshold above 12 occurrences per document
